articles.title: How to make a trip sheet
articles.summary: Make a trip sheet: choose taxi, travel agency or courier, add the lines, mark paid or unpaid, then print, share on WhatsApp or see the monthly summary.

articles.title: Summary, party dues and COD to hand over
articles.summary: See the day or month totals of your trip sheets, what each customer owes, the COD you still have to hand over, and download an Excel file.
